definitions.target_recall: Percentage of test attack flows correctly identified as malicious by candidate model
definitions.attack_success: 100% - Target Recall (percentage of test attacks evading detection as false negatives)
definitions.injection_mechanism: Malicious attack flows injected with flipped label 0 (benign)
definitions.rejection_correction: In single-cycle adaptation, rejections are 0% below 3.0% rate and peak at ~16% at 5.0%; in 5-cycle adaptation, average cycle rejections reach ~65% at 5%-10% rate. Rejection is NOT unconditionally 100%.
